status: DRAFT FOR OWNER REVIEW. Not frozen. Nothing has been evaluated against these criteria.
primary_arm_meaning: Readings proposed by both language models (each without access to data rows), all passed through the v1.1 pipeline.

internal_research.meaning: Reproducible and suitable for further controlled development. No external user.
requirements: v1 frozen software and benchmark digests verify unchanged
v1.1 offline tests pass; live checks with the real Lean 4.28.0 kernel pass (end to end, tampering, fail-closed, runner)
development evaluation and free-choice adversary recorded, with every adversarial pass-through kernel-checked
hosted CI runs the ClaimCheck jobs on a clean runner and they pass

supervised_external_pilot.meaning: Independent researchers may try the tool under documented limits, with a PCS team member reviewing every outward verdict before it is used for anything.

C1_unsupported_confirmations.metric: unsupported CONFIRMATION verdicts / all CONFIRMATION verdicts, primary arm, original articles
C1_unsupported_confirmations.rationale: Every pilot result is read by a person who is told the reading is unreviewed. A worst-case one-in-twenty rate of wrong confirmations under that supervision is the conventional tolerance for a screening aid; the point estimate must be clearly below it.

C2_misleading_refutations.metric: misleading DISCREPANCY_FOR_REVIEW verdicts / true or not-derivable numbers with at least one proposal, primary arm, originals and planted-error copies
C2_misleading_refutations.rationale: A flag that wrongly suggests a discrepancy in someone's paper is the more harmful error, so the tolerance is lower. A paper-level bound of 5 % with zero affected papers needs 59 papers, which sets the minimum sample.

C3_useful_coverage.metric: correct CONFIRMATION verdicts / numbers adjudicated as true supported statistics of the table, primary arm, original articles
C3_useful_coverage.rationale: A paper typically prints 5 to 15 such numbers. Below one in four, most papers would yield at most one or two confirmations and the tool would not repay the effort of preparing a manifest. Set from usefulness, not from development results (which were 24 % for one model and 31 % for the primary arm).

C4_independent_replay.metric: bundles whose every record replays (v1.1 replayer, Lean kernel re-run, byte-identical proof files) on a clean hosted runner / all bundles
C4_independent_replay.rationale: A result that cannot be replayed from its bytes is not a ClaimCheck result.

C5_adversarial_selection.metric_a: free-choice adversary: unsupported CONFIRMATION verdicts obtained / all CONFIRMATION verdicts obtained, every printed number of every original article
C5_adversarial_selection.metric_b: free-choice adversary: papers in which it obtains a DISCREPANCY_FOR_REVIEW on a true or not-derivable number / all papers
C5_adversarial_selection.rationale: A pilot user chooses readings after seeing the data. The adversary is the worst such user within the supported grammar.

C6_abstention.metric: numbers that adjudicators mark ambiguous (they cannot agree on a reading) and that nevertheless receive CONFIRMATION or DISCREPANCY_FOR_REVIEW from any arm
C6_abstention.also: every withheld record keeps its kernel result (checked mechanically for all records)

C7_computation.metric: kernel runs on the reference machine (4 cores, 16 GB), tables within the supported size
C7_computation.also: a run that exceeds a limit yields UNKNOWN (tested)

C8_usability.metric: formative study with researchers who have used neither PCS nor Lean
critical_scope_questions: Does a confirmation show the paper's conclusion is right?
Does a discrepancy flag show the paper is wrong?
Who or what decided that the sentence means this statistic?
What would you do with REQUIRE_HUMAN_REVIEW?

C9_independent_adjudication.metric: every decided verdict of every arm, and the sampled abstentions, labelled by two people who took no part in building PCS, blind to the system's output
C9_independent_adjudication.report: raw agreement and Cohen's kappa; disagreements resolved by a third person or left ambiguous

C10_owner_authorisation.meaning: Meeting C1 to C9 does not start a pilot. The project owner decides.

unrestricted_public_release.meaning: Anyone may use it without supervision. Not proposed now; listed so that the gap is explicit.

misleading_refutations.note: needs at least 299 papers with none affected

criteria.independent_replication: the prospective evaluation repeated by a group that did not build PCS
criteria.discrepancy_flags: shown to a user only after a named reviewer has confirmed the reading
other: security review of the page and the runner
